title: Task Recording Choice
description: Read or begin this task's recording choice, the person's question in the standard side panel bottom sheet. Every task is asked: page.open and a scrape wizard.start ask. Poll dsagent.agent.work.recording.state while pending; never choose for the person.
guidance: Once recording, use wizard.state with wizardId and wizardToken, perform the task, finish-recording, read every page of wizard.recording.steps, clean the draft with wizard.recording.edit, answer workflow-details and wizard.save. Do not call wizard.run: the task has already executed. Then agent.work.finish ends the task. Collections: purpose collection; create-workflow keeps the collection wizard's workflow, else collect once (wizard.run once true). A cancelled choice never permits page actions.

inputSchema.description: The task page and purpose for a choice not started yet.

pageContextId.description: A page belonging to this task.

purpose.description: browser: create-workflow records the task; collection: it keeps the collection wizard's workflow.

outputSchema.description: The person's choice (in the sheet, or passed on with recording.choose) and the recording it started.

status.description: Wait while pending or starting; only recording and not-recording permit task actions. Failed means recording could not be started or its start was interrupted; stop and report it.

recordingActive.description: False after recording stops; further task page actions are refused.

keepWorkflow.description: False: collect once (wizard.run once true), never save.

wizardId.description: The standard guided recording wizard; finish, clean and save this draft.

wizardToken.description: Ownership token; keep it with the wizard id.
